output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    toc: false
params:
  report: null

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=TRUE,error=FALSE)
r <- params$report
esc <- function(x) as.character(htmltools::htmlEscape(ifelse(is.na(x),'',as.character(x))))
table_html <- function(x) {
  if (!nrow(x)) return('<p class="muted">No records in this snapshot.</p>')
  paste0('<div class="table-wrap">',paste(knitr::kable(x,format='html',escape=TRUE),collapse='\n'),'</div>')
}
panel <- function(title,x) cat('<details><summary>',esc(title),'</summary>',table_html(x),'</details>')
```

<p class="eyebrow">Science &amp; restoration integration · model review</p>
<p class="lead">What can existing science tell us about the mussel habitat benefit anticipated at Steamboat Island—and what would we need to know before evaluating it here?</p>
<div class="banner"><strong>Read this as a design prototype.</strong> The plan anticipates an ancillary benefit. It does not establish a post-construction mussel response, an adopted local hypothesis or a project-success determination.</div>
<nav class="navline" aria-label="Report sections"><a href="#path">Evidence pathway</a><a href="#plan">Project plan</a><a href="#science">Scientific basis</a><a href="#newton">Newton study</a><a href="#review">What remains open</a><a href="#records">Explore records</a></nav>

## An evidence pathway {#path}

The model connects objects with different meanings. The proposed links below are prompts for investigation, not established causal steps.

<div class="path"><div><span>01 · INTENT</span>Restoration plan and ancillary mussel benefit</div><div><span>02 · QUESTION</span>Substrate conditions and mussel response</div><div><span>03 · SCIENCE</span>Studies, observations and reported findings</div><div><span>04 · APPLICATION</span>Local evidence and future assessment</div></div>

```{r orientation, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="grid"><div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">Source-reported plan</span><strong>',esc(r$benefit$classification),'</strong><p>',esc(r$benefit$survey_commitment),'.</p></div>',
    '<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">What has been modeled</span><strong>',nrow(r$objectives),' objectives · ',nrow(r$criteria),' planned criteria</strong><p>These are planning records, not evaluated outcomes.</p></div>',
    '<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">Research context</span><strong>',nrow(r$chain),' Newton evidence components</strong><p>Source-to-data trace with qualifications and unresolved checks.</p></div></div>')
```

## The project plan {#plan}

The feasibility extraction identifies formal project objectives separately from an ancillary mussel-habitat benefit. Its objectives and criteria are shown as reported and grouped by the analyst; their correspondence to EMMA records has not been established.

```{r objectives, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="grid">')
for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$objectives))) {o<-r$objectives[i,]; cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">',esc(o$objective_id),'</span><strong>',esc(o$objective_name),'</strong><p>',esc(o$normalized_text),'</p></div>')}
cat('</div>')
cat('<p class="muted small">External data opportunity: ',esc(r$benefit$external_data_opportunity),'.</p>')
panel('Explore all 11 planned criterion assertions',r$criteria)
panel('Explore five proposed response triggers',r$triggers)
```

## The scientific bridge {#science}

The hypothesis below was formulated for review using selected science. The arrows describe how the ideas informed its formulation; they do not show that local designers adopted it or that the intervention caused an effect.

```{r hypothesis, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="hypothesis"><span class="pill">Assistant proposed · SC-08</span><p>',esc(r$hypothesis$hypothesis_text),'</p><p class="small">',esc(r$hypothesis$limitation),'</p></div>')
selected <- r$assertions[r$assertions$assertion_id %in% r$derivations$informed_by_id[r$derivations$assertion_id=='SC-08'],]
cat('<div class="grid">')
for(i in seq_len(nrow(selected))) {a<-selected[i,]; cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">',esc(a$assertion_id),' · ',esc(a$source_id),'</span><strong>',esc(a$assertion_kind),'</strong><p>',esc(a$paraphrase),'</p><p class="meta">',esc(a$limitation),'</p></div>')}
cat('</div>')
```

## Following the Newton study {#newton}

```{r instance, results='asis'}
cat('<p>',esc(r$instance$reading_depth),' ',esc(r$instance$review_status),'.</p>')
cat('<p><a href="',esc(r$instance$publication_url),'">Publication abstract</a> · <a href="',esc(r$instance$dataset_url),'">Data release ',esc(r$instance$dataset_doi),'</a></p>')
cat('<div class="timeline">')
for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$chain))) {z<-r$chain[i,];cat('<div class="step"><span class="eyebrow">',sprintf('%02d',z$position),' · ',esc(z$basis),'</span><h3>',esc(z$component_type),'</h3><p>',esc(z$description),'</p><p class="meta">Source: ',esc(z$source_locator),'</p></div>')}
cat('</div>')
```

## What still needs attention {#review}

The study's habitat comparison is not a restoration treatment at Steamboat. Before transferring its implications, examine differences in location, species, flow conditions, design and timing. No raw observations or new vital-rate calculations are produced by this report.

```{r checks, results='asis'}
cat('<h3>Newton evidence checks</h3><ul>')
for(flag in r$flags$flag) cat('<li>',esc(flag),'</li>')
cat('</ul><h3>Plan reconciliation questions</h3><ul>')
for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$issues))) cat('<li><strong>',esc(r$issues$issue_id[i]),':</strong> ',esc(r$issues$issue_text[i]),'</li>')
cat('</ul>')
```

## Explore the underlying records {#records}

These tables expose the model's source-based and proposed records. Use the source locators to inspect the evidence; current worksheets and links have not been approved as production EMMA data.

<details><summary>How this example exercises the relational model</summary>
<p>Each arrow below stands for a relationship that can be examined in the model. The planning groupings are analyst-proposed; the science derivations explain a formulation rather than demonstrate an effect.</p>
<div class="path"><div><span>PLAN</span>Source passage → objective → planned criterion and target</div><div><span>RESPONSE</span>Objective → proposed trigger and response</div><div><span>SCIENCE</span>Scientific source → extracted assertion → proposed hypothesis</div><div><span>STUDY</span>Study evidence instance → components, source locators, review flags and files</div></div>
<p>The <a href="https://github.com/MVR-GIS/restorationmonitoring/blob/main/dev/architecture/steamboat-planning-extraction-duckdb.md">planning ERD</a> and <a href="https://github.com/MVR-GIS/restorationmonitoring/blob/main/dev/architecture/research-questions-evidence-relational-design.md">research evidence ERD</a> show the tables and their current boundaries.</p>
</details>

```{r records, results='asis'}
panel('Planning sources and page locators',r$passages)
if(!is.null(r$objective_reconciliation)) panel('Candidate alignment: pilot objective and source worksheet',r$objective_reconciliation)
if(!is.null(r$criterion_reconciliation)) panel('Candidate alignment: pilot criterion and source worksheet',r$criterion_reconciliation)
panel('Single stated targets and comparators',r$target)
panel('Conditions attached to planned targets',r$conditions)
panel('Year-by-year targets as reported',r$series)
panel('Scientific sources and reading depth',r$sources)
panel('Scientific assertions and their limits',r$assertions)
panel('Links describing how assertions informed a formulation',r$derivations)
panel('Newton source files and recorded fingerprints',r$files)
panel('Proposed workshop question connections',r$pilot_links)
panel('All workshop research questions',r$questions)
panel('Workshop reach-specific ranks',r$ranks)
panel('Recorded workshop project marks',r$workbook_marks)
panel('Workshop source and limitations',r$workshop)
cat('<details><summary>Workshop interpretation limits</summary><ul>');for(z in r$workshop_limits$limitation)cat('<li>',esc(z),'</li>');cat('</ul></details>')
```
